narrative.introduction: The Grain & Starch Ontology catalogs canonical culinary grains, pseudocereals, processed grain forms, and starches used worldwide as staple ingredients. This domain models culinary ingredients, not prepared foods or crop science.

narrative.summary: Canonical culinary grains and starches across four immutable groups: Whole Grains, Pseudocereals, Processed Grains, and Starches.
